landing.faq.title: Frequently asked questions
landing.faq.description: How the migrated MediaClaw website fits the extension, workbench, and partner channel model.
landing.faq.stack.question: What changed in the migration?
landing.faq.stack.answer: The website is moving onto TanStack Start with React 19, Vite, Nitro, Drizzle, better-auth, and Cloudflare build support. Pages use API routes and React Query instead of Next app-router handlers.
landing.faq.payment.question: How are purchases connected to activation codes?
landing.faq.payment.answer: Checkout and webhook handling create orders, grant credits, and keep activation-code issuance repairable so operators can recover failed fulfillment without losing audit context.
landing.faq.database.question: Can this run on different database backends?
landing.faq.database.answer: Schema templates are kept for SQLite, PostgreSQL, and MySQL, with Cloudflare D1/Hyperdrive deployment support in the TanStack runtime.
landing.faq.customize.question: How do partners and white-label channels work?
landing.faq.customize.answer: Partners are modeled through one backend with partner codes, variant IDs, seat limits, credential exports, and attribution fields instead of separate forks.
landing.faq.license.question: Where should users manage their account?
landing.faq.license.answer: Users claim activation codes, inspect credits, manage billing, and request referral payouts from the settings workspace. Operators use the admin backend for review and repair.
landing.cta.headline: Ready to run MediaClaw workflows?
landing.cta.subheadline: Install the capture tool, claim an activation code, and keep credits, referrals, and partner channels visible in one workbench.
